content: He who sows the seeds of thorns in the spring must not expect to harvest grapes in autumn.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Az goft-e niki niki zayed (از گفت نیکی نیکی زاید) — Ferdowsi's Shahnameh
explanation: The laws of the moral harvest are as unsparing as the laws of botany: if you scatter seeds of suspicion, gossip, selfishness, and stinginess, the soil will inevitably yield a harvest of thorny isolation and bitter regret. Plant love if you wish to taste sweet fruit.
practicalInsight: Sow one seed of radical kindness or generosity into someone's life today. Trust the autumn harvest.
reflectionPrompt: What kind of seeds are your daily interactions sowing into your relationships?
